$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: The only painted theme: every public www.intercom.com page boots body.theme-light — a cream ground, off-black ink, blueprint blues and the Fin orange. The stylesheet declares no dark theme and no control repaints one, so no dark set exists to capture.
